notes.title: Fjall 1.2.1 patch
notes.notes:
Version 1.2.1:

	Added a 'Mana is too low' message if player tries to use skill and doesn't have enough mana.
	Level Select: Map will now put you on last level completed + 1 (for saved games, you have to complete one level before this will take affect)

	level.7: fixed a jump that could cause player to get stuck.
	level.9: cleaned up some unfair spikes and hitboxes.
	level.36: fixed spawn location.
	
	Build: Added some options for demo build.
	Fixed some typos.
